statement: SELECT count(*) AS n, avg(abs(t.f1-s.f1)) AS mad_f1, avg(abs(t.f2-s.f2)) AS mad_f2, avg(abs(t.f3-s.f3)) AS mad_f3, avg(abs(t.f4-s.f4)) AS mad_f4, avg(abs(t.f5-s.f5)) AS mad_f5, corr(t.f1,s.f1) AS c1, corr(t.f2,s.f2) AS c2, corr(t.f3,s.f3) AS c3, corr(t.f4,s.f4) AS c4, corr(t.f5,s.f5) AS c5 FROM workspace.mlpabcc3ffa.training_sample t JOIN workspace.mlpabcc3ffa.serving_log s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id
